summary: Northern Dynasty Minerals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports a net loss of $15.1 million for the six-month period and a derivative loss on convertible notes of $0.8 million, with total assets of $120.3 million. This is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, reflecting ongoing operations and financial position, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, strategic review, or restructuring. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed; the filing solely provides standard interim financial disclosure.
